listing.name: GrantDeskHQ Grant Reporting
listing.shortDescription: Create and review source-linked post-award grant-report drafts in your GrantDeskHQ tenant.
listing.longDescription: GrantDeskHQ turns an award agreement, approved budget, accounting ledger, and program update into a reviewable, source-linked post-award report draft. It flags missing inputs and calculates budget-versus-actual deterministically. It never submits reports to funders and it cannot access GTM contacts, campaigns, or delivery data.
listing.termsOwnerAction: Provide an approved public GrantDeskHQ Terms URL. Do not invent or substitute a privacy-policy URL.
